scope: Linux spidev laboratory backend, all successful device operations mocked; no physical measurements

compiled_common_header.note: Copied from isolated rootfs work/spidev-lab/src/cnc1.h after successful current-header normal+ASan/UBSan+C++ link regression.

limitations: Synchronous ioctl has no enforced completion deadline.
Advisory flock is cooperative ownership, not system-wide exclusion.
No default HAL profile loads this backend.
No target electrical, timing, device-tree or machine qualification.
initial_failure: Sanitizer initially could not inspect /proc in isolated rootfs. Launcher corrected by mounting proc in private namespaces; both final test runs passed. The retained initial-sanitizer-environment.log was produced from an earlier revision of cnc1/tests/test_spidev.c (840 assertions, all passed before LeakSanitizer aborted); the test source was extended to 892 assertions before the recorded 892-assertion runs, so that log does not correspond to the test_spidev.c hash in source_sha256 and is kept only as the failed-environment record.
regression: Rerun against persistence common header and configurable-rootfs launcher; transport/test sources unchanged
intermediate_regression: intermediate-header-regression.log preserves the first successful header refresh. A launcher change was detected before recording, so the current final run was repeated against the recorded launcher hash.
